idle.prompt: A massive heavy armored soldier stands in a battle ready stance holding a rifle, breathing slowly and shifting weight

walk.prompt: A heavy armored soldier walks forward slowly and menacingly with a rifle held at the chest

run.prompt: A heavy armored soldier runs forward fast carrying a rifle

fall.prompt: A person falls from the sky with arms and legs spread out

land.prompt: A person lands hard from a very high jump in a deep crouch, then slowly stands up straight and looks around

roar.prompt: A person roars angrily and beats their chest with both fists

aim.prompt: A soldier stands aiming a rifle forward with both hands and fires several shots

stomp.prompt: A person raises one foot high and slams it hard onto the ground

slam.prompt: A person raises both fists above the head and smashes them down onto the ground

hit.prompt: A person is hit by a heavy impact and staggers backward

die.prompt: A person is shot, staggers and collapses to the ground dead
